person.description: A natural person who may be born, naturalized, resident, or subject to jurisdiction.

state.description: A U.S. State, i.e. a state-level jurisdiction capable of making or enforcing law.

law.description: A law that a State may make or enforce.

born_in_us.description: Recorded as born in the United States.
born_in_us.verbalisation: {0} was born in the United States

naturalized_in_us.description: Recorded as naturalized in the United States.
naturalized_in_us.verbalisation: {0} was naturalized in the United States

subject_to_us_jurisdiction.description: Recorded as subject to the jurisdiction of the United States.
subject_to_us_jurisdiction.verbalisation: {0} is subject to the jurisdiction of the United States

us_citizen.description: Recorded as a citizen of the United States.
us_citizen.verbalisation: {0} is a citizen of the United States

resides_in.description: Recorded as residing in the state.

citizen_of_state.description: Recorded as a citizen of the state.

abridges_priv_or_imm.description: Recorded as a law that abridges the privileges or immunities of the person as a citizen of the United States. This predicate bundles the entire contested substantive content of 'privileges or immunities' opaquely; see GAPS.md.
abridges_priv_or_imm.verbalisation: {0} abridges the privileges or immunities of {1}

deprives.description: Recorded as the state depriving the person of life, liberty, or property.
deprives.verbalisation: {0} deprives {1} of life, liberty, or property

affords_due_process.description: Recorded as the state affording due process of law to the person for a deprivation. This predicate bundles the entire contested substantive content of 'due process' opaquely; see GAPS.md.
affords_due_process.verbalisation: {0} affords due process of law to {1}

within_jurisdiction_of.description: Recorded as the person being within the jurisdiction of the state.

denies_equal_protection.description: Recorded as the state denying the person the equal protection of the laws. This predicate bundles the entire contested substantive content of 'equal protection' opaquely; see GAPS.md.
denies_equal_protection.verbalisation: {0} denies the equal protection of the laws to {1}
